name: @openpos/web
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves the shared OpenPOS web client for every store subdomain

scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:client && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../api/wrangler.jsonc --local-upstream demo.localhost:8787
